slides.headline: How a 65-year-old turned tech into $25,000 liquidity.
The Illusion of Romance Scams vs. Institutional Reality
slides.card_text: Retail investors dismiss this as a dating app anomaly. Institutions categorize this as Synthetic Identity Fraud (SIF). The 65-year-old perpetrator utilized AI to bypass KYC verification, proving that automated social engineering is now the primary vector for unauthorized retail brokerage account hijacking and liquidation.

slides.headline: The Mechanism of Automated Hijacking
slides.card_text: Bad actors now use deepfake voice and video to bypass biometric identity checks. Once inside, they execute unauthorized high-frequency trades to drain account liquidity. This is not a human-to-human crime; it is an automated, scalable attack on the weak security architecture of standard retail trading platforms.

slides.headline: The Hidden Liquidity Trap
slides.card_text: When an account is compromised, the attacker does not just steal cash; they use the account to execute wash trades or pump-and-dump schemes. Retail investors become the involuntary exit liquidity for institutional-grade bad actors, leaving the victim with zeroed-out positions and a destroyed credit profile.

slides.headline: The Cost of Security Negligence
slides.card_text: A single account breach results in a 100% loss of principal. When factoring in the recovery time, legal fees, and the opportunity cost of lost capital, the erosion of your net worth is absolute. Relying on outdated security is a mathematical guarantee of eventual total portfolio failure.

slides.headline: The Non-Negotiable Institutional Rule
slides.card_text: Abandon SMS-based OTPs immediately. They are compromised by AI-driven SIM-swapping and interception. You must implement hardware-based 2FA, such as a YubiKey, for all brokerage and banking portals. If your broker does not support physical security keys, your capital is currently at high, unnecessary risk.

slides.headline: The Pre-Trade Security Audit
slides.card_text: Before allocating capital, perform this 3-point audit: 1. Enable hardware-based 2FA. 2. Disable all SMS-based recovery options. 3. Set up real-time trade execution alerts via email. If you cannot verify the security of your account, you are not investing; you are gambling with an exposed balance.
